Lina: FYI I opened a PR to consolidate pricing + quotas + usage-analytics guidance: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/158. Main goals: simplify the tier table, add migration notes for Dedicated customers moving to per-token billing, include a short Go SDK retry snippet for 429s, and refresh Console screenshots for the new 'endpoints' UI. PTAL when you can.
Ravi: skimmed. please be explicit about "metering" vs "rate limiting". they get conflated in the doc right now.
Lina: good call. I added a small section: "Metering = how we bill (requests vs tokens). Rate limiting = runtime throttles/enforcement (rps, concurrent requests)."
Eli: billing check: Free & Trial remain request-metered (calls only). Starter becomes request-metered but with a soft token cap. Standard is token-metered. Enterprise defaults to token-metered but offers committed token tiers and hybrid options. Can you include that exact phrasing? Customers ping us if it's vague.
Lina: added Eli's phrasing and an extra FAQ line: "Can I keep request-based billing?" -> "Enterprise onboarding can opt into request-based meters for approved use cases."
Nora: Screenshots: Console staging changed the metric name from "tokens" to "token_count" last week. I'll capture a staging shot and add alt text. Also will include a small per-endpoint sparkline gallery.
Lina: thanks. the docs currently reference the old dropdown label (routes). changed to endpoints where appropriate.
doc-lint-bot: warning: pricing table uses mixed placeholder styles ($TOKEN_COST vs {{ token_cost }}). Recommend using {{token_cost}} throughout. Also detected an unreachable image link (assets/pricing/old-graph.png).
Lina: will normalize placeholders to {{token_cost}} and replace the image.
Elena: Support here 4ac. Drafted a migration blurb for Dedicated customers mapping old quota types to the new per-token meter:
- Old: GPU-hour commitment -> New: committed token tiers with option to set equivalent monthly spend.
- Old: per-instance concurrent request cap -> New: per-organization rate limits + burst allowances.
- Action: we will run a one-week runbook for customers with >500k monthly tokens to review mappings.
Sam: I'll paste that blurb into the PR as a comment and add a minimal migration checklist for Solutions Eng.
Lina: ideal. Can Support also provide a short sample email we can copy into the migration guide?
Elena: on it.
Ravi: docs content nit: under "Rate limit examples" you list "Starter: 100 rps". Could we add a short humanized example line e.g., "100 rps ~= 15 concurrent short chats (avg 256 tokens)" so users can map it to their traffic.
Lina: added humanized mappings below each tier.
Nora: uploading screenshots in PR in a sec. note: the saved query language uses SQL-like syntax. here's an example for per-endpoint spend to include in the docs: `SELECT endpoint AS ep, SUM(token_count) AS tokens FROM usage_events WHERE org_id = :org GROUP BY ep ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 20;`
Lina: perfect, will add that as a copyable Saved Query.
Sam: also suggested adding a short Go snippet showing simple exponential backoff for 429s. I drafted one and pushed it to the PR: 
```go
func SendWithRetry(ctx context.Context, client *redwood.Client, req *redwood.GenerateRequest) (*redwood.GenerateResponse, error) {
  var lastErr error
  for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
    resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, req)
    if err == nil {
      return resp, nil
    }
    lastErr = err
    if !isRateLimitErr(err) {
      return nil, err
    }
    sleep := time.Duration(math.Pow(2, float64(i))) * 200 * time.Millisecond
    time.Sleep(sleep + time.Duration(rand.Intn(100))*time.Millisecond)
  }
  return nil, lastErr
}
```
Sam: also included a note about idempotency keys for batched calls.
doc-lint-bot: all placeholder recommendations applied in PR. one remaining suggestion: prefer "per-endpoint" phrasing consistently instead of mixing with "per-route".
Lina: updated language to per-endpoint. added changelog note and set the PR to merge-on-green once screenshots land. Thanks everyone!
Eli: approved once Support email draft is in the PR.
Nora: screenshots uploaded (staging).
Elena: email draft added.
Lina: merging after CI. will queue a docs release note for next Friday. :rocket:
